title: RSSB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 874 Junior Engineer Posts
description: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has declared the official notification for 2026. Allotted 874 vacancies for Junior Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have qualifed in B.E/ B.Tech, Diploma in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for these posts.
